hook_text: One sports day, two terms of maths. From the gate to the medal table in sixty seconds.
clip_script: Sports day in Polokwane. Gate: 1 248 learners, the 4 is worth 40, nearest hundred 1 200. Plus 375 visitors: 1 623. Estimate 1 650, close. 486 leave: take 500, give back 14, 1 137. Track: 8 lanes, 24 runners each, 8 times 24 is 192. Heats of 8: 192 divided by 8 is 24. Multiply back to check. Medals: 16 boxes of 25, halve and double, 8 times 50, 400. Ribbons in squares: 4, 7, 10, 13, add 3, picture 10 is 31. Fare table 17, 29, 41, 53: times 12 then plus 5. Store: boxes are prisms, tins are cylinders, balls are spheres, the trophy is a pyramid. Flag: fold it, no line of symmetry; the square flagpole base, four. Every topic, one day. Estimate, show working, check, read to the end.
visual_style: Whiteboard sports field map with each station lighting up as its skill appears; small sums and shape sketches beside each landmark.
mood: Energetic highlight reel with a steady beat.
pacing: Seven fast stations, one skill each, then the four-habit close.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a one-page map of Terms 1 and 2 before the test.
